name: fury
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "fury" %}
{% set version = "2.0.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 35891b750219719a7a01b77b0e0ade424d64513fee96f4efc54297aca6d002ef

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --no-build-isolation -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - hatchling
    - hatch-vcs

  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=2.0
    - scipy >=1.13.0
    - pillow >=10.4.0
    - packaging >=23.0
    - lazy_loader >=0.4
    - pygfx >=0.16.0
    - pyglfw >=2.7.0
    - aiohttp
    # `polyxios >=0.2.0` is an upstream run dependency but is not yet packaged
    # on conda-forge (it is a Cython extension package, so it cannot be built
    # here as `noarch: python`). It is only imported by `fury.io`, which is
    # lazily loaded, so the rest of the package is unaffected. Add it back once
    # a polyxios-feedstock exists.

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - fury

about:
  home: https://github.com/fury-gl/fury
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_family: BSD
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Free Unified Rendering for Python - Scientific Visualization
  description: |
    FURY (Free Unified Rendering in pYthon) is a free and open-source software
    library for Scientific Visualization and 3D animations. Built on top of
    pygfx and WebGPU, it provides primitives, actors, UI widgets and shaders
    for building interactive scientific visualizations.
  doc_url: https://fury.gl/
  dev_url: https://github.com/fury-gl/fury

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - skoudoro
    - garyfallidis
    - maharshi-gor
